sections.kicker: Prepared for Munch by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Munch has a voice in a sticker and an idea in the subline. The headline has neither.
sections.keep: The speech bubble, "Your local best is PROPERLY on MUNCH!" It sounds like a person, not an app.

meet first.

pins.quote: Trọn vẹn trải nghiệm, dành riêng cho bạn.
pins.what: The headline could sit on any lifestyle app.
pins.why: This is why it looks like everyone else: a complete experience just for you is what every app promises.
pins.how: Write the headline about restaurants and the city, in the voice of your bubble.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Diners and restaurants file Munch with every other deals app.

pins.area: A speech bubble on the photo says your local best is properly on Munch
pins.what: Your best line is a sticker on a photo.
pins.why: It has attitude and local pride, the opposite of a template.
pins.how: Promote this voice to the headline and the whole page.
pins.label: Your bubble
pins.cost: The line with character stays decoration.

pins.what: City challenges come last in the subline.
pins.why: It is the part EatClub and Luma do not lead with, so it is where Munch can own a place.
pins.how: Build the brand around the city challenge, not the offer.
pins.label: Your subline
pins.cost: Munch competes on deals, where the larger players win.

sections.intro: You told us Munch looks like everyone else, and that you want to be the center of restaurant loyalty in Vietnam. Here is what the front door says today.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Munch's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
